# Interactive visualization lab

These visualizations are compiled from R during the Quarto render and published as static HTML assets. They do not use Shiny, an iframe, or a runtime application server.
:::

## Linked World Bank explorer

Click a country line or point to change the active selection. Use the year controls to animate the scatterplot through time.

::: {.animint-panel .animint-panel-wide}
```{r}
#| label: linked-worldbank-animint
source("R/animint-demos.R")
linked_animint_demo()
```
:::

## How it works

The first plot uses `clickSelects` to update the selected country. The scatterplot uses `showSelected` to display a single year, while the `time` and `duration` options animate that selection. Animint2's knitr print method writes the plot specification and browser dependencies into the rendered site.

## Static publishing contract

The production check verifies that the rendered visualization includes `plot.json`, local data assets, JavaScript, and CSS. Netlify only needs to serve these static files.
